value.pads: RGB888, common positive PCLK sample stage

value.write_interface: Pango AW + WREADY/WLAST; no WVALID and no application B channel; beat0 may coincide with AW accept
value.read_interface: RID must be 0; RVALID responses cannot be backpressured; reserve all response room before AR
value.source_descriptor_queue: single source_valid/bank/id/CRC/pixels mailbox; no independent queued-descriptor FIFO

value.input: active-low KEY1 on C23 LVCMOS33 pullup
value.debounce: 2FF; release then press each stable 2500000 core clocks (20ms at125MHz); held-at-reset does not toggle
value.mode_lock_edge: bank source_valid && source_ready captures active_corrected together with source_bank/source_id
value.engine_start: following start drives a joint begin_frame only while core and writer are ready; engine tile traversal, mapper and writer all latch the same frozen bank mode
value.raw_mode: identity coordinates in raster order through the same DDR/CRC/display ownership pipeline
value.corrected_mode: 8x8 traversal, fixed fisheye coordinates and dualstripe raster restoration
value.display_change: later complete result lease at output frame boundary; no asynchronous video mux
value.led: LED6 reports requested mode, not confirmed visible frame mode

facts.limits: An input frame already captured but not yet accepted by the bank may take the new mode at its bank handshake. A processed/displayed frame has id/bank/CRC/epoch, but no explicit mode field in the saved descriptor or UART; requested bit alone is not a visible-mode acknowledgement.

value.capture: reservation held across pixel/core domains; first DE after VS with grant begins whole frame; missing grant/geometry/overflow discards whole frame
commit_requires: capture FIFO and registered pending return drained
value.source_offer: valid descriptor retained while bank !source_ready; capture reservation remains owned until processing release
value.source_bank_release: only engine_done and matching completed result base/id; not on KEY1, timeout or display request

value.writer: two complete eight-row stripe RAMs; whole RGB/tag elastic output; immutable 256-pixel/16-beat burst buffer from AW presentation through final W transfer
value.result_pending: only writer_done after every beat and writer drain; bank validates completed_base/id then records pending CRC/id
lease_release_requires: reader_done with full beats and CRC
pixel done matching id/bank/epoch/CRC/full pixel count
value.refresh_without_ready_front: blank grant at that refresh boundary, never late midpicture grant
value.repeat: old front may be leased again; scan_repeat counted separately; unique_presented increases only for newer result id

value.stall: ready/valid governs coordinate, pixel/tag and descriptor progress; read/write arbiters retain whole-burst owner and held address; never cancel a visible AW/AR on mode change
value.fault: sticky quarantine; no partial result publish and no bad lease release; display fault drains queued/future returned FIFO data but remains failed until coordinated reset
value.runtime_watchdog: top watches PCLK activity only; timeout is not VS/DE/frame-progress validation and does not reset a transaction or free bank
value.reset: only manual/power common reset asserts DDR/capture/FIFO/scan epoch reset; two-flop local releases; startup release monotonic; runtime fault stops admission rather than local reset
value.address_stall_limit: write/read arbiters do not time out a held ADDRESS before DDR acceptance; 26-bit watchdogs chiefly guard service stalls after address acceptance; reader also times ROOM/AR
value.simultaneous_fault_veto: system qualifies delayed display_done_valid with !failed on bank consumption edge

facts.limits: Source inspection is not a new formal proof of all arbitrary fault/service combinations. Offline acceptance must retain outstanding transactions and epoch rules; do not promise general independent-domain reset or clock-stop recovery.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: source-and-module-selection
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Freeze exact main/package/110-source manifest, six compiled deltas and final selected flags; explicit module mapping finds one definition per used module; no legacy top/engine mixed in.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: key1-debounce-and-reset
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Held-low at reset no toggle; continuous release then press threshold; bounce at both edges; press hold toggles once; repeat after qualified release; corrected reset default.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: mode-to-source-id-scoreboard
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Record cfg_corrected at src_valid&&src_ready; toggle before/after that edge, during SCAN, writer drain, pending front and active scan. Every output result id matches its frozen mode, complete pixel/tag/CRC scoreboards; no mixed frame. Do not use UART request bit as completion ack.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: stalls-and-bursts
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Random stalls at core/writer ready and AW/ARREADY/WREADY/RVALID; allow beat0 with AW; whole address/owner/payload remain stable; accepted beat counts/last/id agree and no interleaving.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: banks-and-publication
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Four 4MiB slots only; no source overwrite while offered/processing; no result overwrite while leased; only complete frame publish; exact pixel count, CRC and id/epoch checks; repeats and blanks distinguished.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: fault-and-common-epoch
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Inject wrong RID/RLAST/WLAST/tag/count/CRC, missing reservation, overflow, stalled clocks and simultaneous release+fault. No false result success or lease release; outstanding AW retained; drain then sticky quarantine; only coordinated reset clears epoch.

offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.name: physical-and-board-followup
offline_acceptance_plan_not_executed.pass_criteria: Separate owner task reconstructs final physical flow, pins/clock/IP/constraint identity and actual bit; fresh native signoff then authorized SRAM board optical/mode tests. Offline suite does not grant timing or hardware acceptance.
